headline: Operations Coordinator | Logistics & Supply Chain Enthusiast
summary: Detail-oriented professional with 4 years of experience in operations and supply chain management. Proven track record in optimizing logistics, managing vendor relationships, and enhancing organizational efficiency within the Nepali market.

experiences.title: Operations Specialist
description: Coordinated last-mile delivery operations across Kathmandu valley, reducing delivery lead time by 15%.
Managed a fleet of 50+ delivery riders and optimized daily routing schedules.
Resolved customer delivery escalations by liaising with warehouse and dispatch teams.

experiences.title: Supply Chain Intern
description: Assisted in inventory tracking for automotive spare parts using SAP ERP.
Coordinated with regional dealers to ensure timely supply of vehicle components.
Conducted weekly warehouse audits to identify stock discrepancies.

experiences.title: Volunteer Coordinator
description: Organized community outreach programs across Lalitpur, coordinating logistics for 200+ participants.
Managed event procurement and vendor negotiations for small-scale NGO events.
